passive.name: Way of the Wanderer
passive.text: Yasuo's Critical Strike Chance is increased. Additionally, Yasuo builds toward a shield whenever he is moving. The shield triggers when he takes damage from a champion or monster.

spells.name: Steel Tempest
spells.text: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks Airborne.Steel Tempest is treated as a basic attack and scales with all the same things.

spells.name: Wind Wall
spells.text: Creates a moving wall that blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Sweeping Blade
spells.text: Dashes through target enemy, dealing magic damage. Each cast increases subsequent dash's damage, up to a max amount.Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds.If Steel Tempest is cast while dashing, it will strike as a circle.

spells.name: Last Breath
spells.text: Blinks to an Airborne enemy champion, dealing physical damage and holding all Airborne enemies in the area in the air. Grants maximum Flow but resets all stacks of Gathering Storm.For a moderate time afterwards, Yasuo's critical strikes gain significant Bonus Armor Penetration.

damage.value: Yasuo deals sustained damage with repeated Steel Tempest casts, magic damage with Sweeping Blade, and physical damage with Last Breath.

archetype.value: Yasuo is a mobile fighter who dashes through enemies and follows airborne targets with Last Breath.

axis.value: Yasuo can poke with Steel Tempest, then commit when its whirlwind knocks a target airborne.

winCondition.value: Yasuo follows knockups with R to catch multiple enemies or a carry in teamfights.

spikes.why: Yasuo's next Steel Tempest fires a whirlwind that knocks enemies airborne.
Yasuo's critical strikes gain bonus armor penetration for a moderate time.

bait.why: Yasuo cannot block projectiles with Wind Wall while it is on cooldown, creating a window after he spends it.
Yasuo cannot immediately dash through the same enemy again, creating a window after he uses Sweeping Blade on that target.

mistakes.value: Yasuo loses his Gathering Storm stacks when he casts Last Breath, so expecting a ready whirlwind afterward is a mistake.
